title: LAMPO: Large Language Models as Preference Machines for Few-shot Ordinal Classification

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating how the arrangement and sequence of few-shot demonstrations within a prompt drastically affects LLM performance, and mitigating this position/ordering bias by using a pairwise comparative framework that makes dual LLM calls with swapped orderings.

Measuring an LLM's inherent a priori preference for predicting certain answers regardless of the input text, evaluated using contextual calibration methods that request prediction probabilities for content-free inputs (e.g., 'N/A').
